CommunityApplications.Profile: MeiXu 的 Unraid Community Applications 模板库：每个应用一个模板，镜像在各自的 GitHub 仓库构建与发布。目前收录 DSH（DeepSeek Harness，浏览器里用的开源 AI 编码智能体）：多架构镜像随上游发版自动重建，内置 bubblewrap 以适配没有 Landlock 的 Unraid 内核，并提供中英文安装文档与沙箱说明；容器内置 Caddy 反向代理、可选口令门禁与 ALLOWED_CLIENTS 白名单，以非 root 身份（PUID/PGID）运行。每个应用的支持请走其模板 Support 字段指向的论坛帖；库级支持入口见本 profile 的 Forum。 | MeiXu's Unraid Community Applications template library: one template per app, with each image built and released in its own GitHub repository. It currently ships DSH (DeepSeek Harness), an open-source AI coding agent you drive from the browser: a multi-arch image rebuilt automatically for each upstream release, with bubblewrap bundled for Unraid kernels that lack Landlock, plus installation and sandbox documentation in Chinese and English; the container bundles its reverse proxy, an optional password gate and an ALLOWED_CLIENTS allowlist, and runs unprivileged as PUID/PGID. Support for each app goes through the forum thread named in that template's Support field; the library-level support entry is the Forum link in this profile.
